name: sacrament-site
description: Sacrament website, VTT, character builder and the password-gated node builder, for Netlify.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-private.mjs && node scripts/build-landing.mjs && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 300 node --test --test-timeout=60000 'test/*.test.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 600 playwright test --workers=2 --grep-invert "@phone|text and buttons are readable" && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 300 playwright test e2e/contrast.spec.mjs --workers=1 --grep-invert @phone
scripts.test:browser-suites: node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 900 node scripts/vtt/e2e.cjs && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 900 node scripts/vtt/flow.cjs && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 300 node scripts/hearts/ui-test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:contrast
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:browser-suites && npm run phone-check
scripts.hearts-validate: node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 120 node scripts/hearts/validate.mjs && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 120 node scripts/hearts/docs.mjs
scripts.test:contrast: node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 240 CONTRAST_SET=quick playwright test e2e/contrast.spec.mjs --workers=2 --grep-invert @phone
scripts.phone-suite: npm run phone-check && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 600 playwright test --workers=2 --grep @phone --grep-invert "text and buttons" && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 300 CONTRAST_SET=quick playwright test e2e/contrast.spec.mjs --grep @phone && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 900 PHONE=1 node scripts/vtt/e2e.cjs && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 900 PHONE=1 node scripts/vtt/flow.cjs && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 300 PHONE=1 node scripts/hearts/ui-test.cjs
scripts.check:live: npm run live-check && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 600 VTT_BASE=https://playsacrament.com playwright test --workers=2 --grep-invert @phone && node scripts/with-timeout.mjs 600 VTT_BASE=https://playsacrament.com node scripts/vtt/flow.cjs
